alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A yellow kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes proudly waters a leafy plant, stretching tall with a chime. On the far right a second plant already lies drooping. A brick-red figure looks at the plants with narrowed eyes. The watered plant slowly leans over and droops too. The first figure's eyes go wide, it trembles, then narrows its eyes at the camera and, undeterred, strikes a proud stretch. The text stays: i'm a plant person. the plants disagree.
